03 / FIND A WAY THROUGH

A route is only useful if you can take it.

Checks closures, access needs, modeled hazards, and room for your whole group.

Show the model, the limits, and what gets exported

Time: reserve draw = 1 − supply coverage. After modeled depletion, oxygen drops 0.015 percentage points/min (up to 1.5), CO₂ rises 14 ppm/min, and temperature rises 0.025°C/min. These are fictional rehearsal assumptions, not a forecast.

Fairness: both policies receive exactly the same power budget. The comparison policy fills upper-level demand first. The community policy protects proportional essentials, then weights unmet demand by vulnerability and hazards. Coverage is not a count of lives saved.

Movement: route cost = walking minutes × (1 + destination risk score / 100). Closed tunnels and inaccessible stairs are removed. Refuges need space for the entire group and cannot have critical destination readings. Intermediate critical levels are explicitly flagged. Capacities are simulated snapshots; no places are reserved.

Transfer: a response brief exports the inputs, assumptions, allocation, and route as JSON. It is a planning document, separate from an importable family relay packet. Nothing is dispatched automatically. Use the Community relay to save and transfer check-ins.

02 / SHARED SURVIVAL

Scarcity is real.
Who gets help shouldn’t be a mystery.

Protect an essential share for every level, then prioritize unmet need, vulnerability, and current hazards. Every unit is accounted for.

01Essentials first

Short supply is shared in proportion to essential need.

02Need over privilege

The remainder follows vulnerability and risk, capped at each level’s demand.

09 / SEE WHAT THE NEIGHBORHOOD SEES

Respiratory health signals

FICTIONAL REHEARSAL

NEIGHBORHOODPRIOR DAYTODAYSIGNAL / EVIDENCENEXT STEP

Counts = people reporting respiratory symptoms / people observed. Demo review rule: at least 5 reports and a reporting rate at least twice the prior day’s rate, with an actual increase. Uneven sampling and incomplete days can distort comparisons. No tally means unknown.

Add or review a daily tally

One reconciled tally per neighborhood per UTC day. Saving replaces that day’s tally; importing the same record never adds its count twice. Reconcile overlapping groups before updating. Use fictional aggregate data only.

    What’s happening?

    LIFE UNDERGROUND

    A signal of our own.

    Hollow Signal connects crisis rehearsal, equitable resource planning, refuge routing, community health signals, care logistics, and offline family check-ins in one community tool.

    All environmental readings are fictional. Warning thresholds and allocations are transparent demonstration rules, not validated forecasts or safety guidance. Water scores cannot establish potability.

    Data is stored in this browser, without encryption. Relay packets move manually between devices; there is no radio mesh, live sensor feed, or emergency dispatch service.
